name: Gate alias sequence normalization (exact holdout API)
task_prompt: Respond with a single runnable Python file using only numpy and the standard library. Define every required function with the EXACT names given; a missing or misnamed entry point fails immediately. Include assert-based self-tests that fail loudly, print nothing on success, and use no randomness or remote services. Implement gate alias normalization: normalize_gate_sequence(gates) mapping lowercase aliases {h, hadamard} -> H, {x, pauli_x} -> X, {cx, cnot} -> CX in order, raising ValueError on any unknown gate string. Strip surrounding whitespace before lookup. Assert [h, CX, pauli_x, hadamard] normalizes to [H, CX, X, H], that an unknown token such as toffoli raises ValueError, and that the empty list normalizes to the empty list.
